blocking_findings.description: The duplicate guard tracks only the derived unit string. For an INSTRUMENT plan with two arms and n_per_arm=1, retain one pre-freeze clip and one post-freeze Evidence record. Two distinct InstrumentRun IDs can both reference that exact Evidence, with one matching EvidenceArm link per arm; evidence_roles.validate_admission permits these records. Submitting that Evidence pin once for each arm selects different POST_FREEZE_RUN links, produces distinct run:<id> units and satisfies both counts. No check rejects reuse of the Evidence pin. A stopping design likewise accepts a stopping.samples list containing that pin twice because it compares sorted multisets without checking uniqueness. This defeats Plan criterion 5's duplicate-submission/cross-arm-reuse requirement and the documented duplicate-sample rejection. The existing instrument regression uses two revisions of the same run ID, so it misses this path.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Reject duplicate submitted Evidence identities across arms independently of run-unit deduplication, and enforce uniqueness of stopping sample references. Add a fresh-event regression with one exact Evidence pin, two distinct valid instrument-run IDs and matching links in different arms; assert the specific duplicate rejection and unchanged event/reference counts. Preserve the positive case with distinct Evidence and run lineages.
